recoveredFacts: All 30 selected skill ranks, source promotion/potential talents, regular attack modes and original facing event payloads are retained. Ranged Attack hits at .467s, blocked Combat at .333s; S2 replacement Attack and Combat both hit at .467s.

Talent1 checks a source-specific first-hit mark before binding and triggering ATK theft. Native steal-atk ends both target and owner contributions when the victim becomes invalid; S2 steal-ASPD ends the victim contribution but retains the owner contribution until its mode ends.

S1 applies a non-independent damage buff with selected bleed_duration, triggerInterval1 and firstTriggerInterval.9. ON_BUFF_START grants DP and snapshots source ATK times bleed_atk_scale; later ticks use fixed magical damage and ignore SP recovery.

S2 applies invisibility, selected ATK and mode1. Its before-target modifier action triggers ASPD theft, while output damage grants selected DP. The mode swap replaces original ranged/blocked/Idle clips separately.

Shadow Sentry is a persistent projectile, not a character-table summon. Original guard uses fixed range2-2, source direction, immediate reach, infinite lifetime and no stop when the original source becomes invalid. It removes enemy buffs on exit/stop and ignores target-free/camouflage while revealing/slowing both ground and air.

S3 first branch is gated by ines_s_3[deck], uses Start_Skill and a summon-replacement buff with withdrawal on owner-locate. Initial card runtimeCost0 and respawn0/not_add_respawn_cost_cnt1 are separate native card behaviors.

S3 normal branch adds ATK/mode2 and retrieves managed sentries after triggerInterval.03; its guarded return projectile travels at speed10, radius1 scaled from projectile_range, caps hits using selected max_target, cannot hit the same victim repeatedly and carries a distinct serialized Physical damage action.

All six recursively referenced projectile trees, nine native buff templates and fixed/selected ranges are retained. Original particle keys remain evidence and are not rendered or counted as model support.
holdReasons: Source foundation only. Persistent Shadow Sentry ownership, first-deployment S3 replacement and its retrieval projectile require explicit runtime adapters before enabling the complete kit.
Native C# dispatch, same-frame ordering, original particles/audio and modules have not been recovered.
